subject.title: fix(gateway): bound session catalog refresh pressure

question: Should overloaded distinct `sessions.catalog.list` requests intentionally receive bounded stale data or `UNAVAILABLE`, rather than queueing or continuing to launch provider scans?
rationale: This is a caller-visible Gateway behavior change under load; focused tests establish mechanics but do not establish that stale-or-unavailable is the desired product contract for Control UI and other clients.

options.title: Accept the bounded overload contract
options.body: Keep stale fallback and `UNAVAILABLE`, provided redacted live proof shows the UI and RPC callers recover clearly after pressure clears.

options.title: Choose a different overload contract
options.body: Pause this PR and specify queueing, retry guidance, or another overload behavior before merging the coordinator.

recommendation.title: Accept the bounded overload contract
recommendation.body: Keep stale fallback and `UNAVAILABLE`, provided redacted live proof shows the UI and RPC callers recover clearly after pressure clears.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main work touches the session-catalog consumer and Gateway-facing catalog shape, though ownership evidence is limited.
